nodes.title: 统一首都货币
nodes.original_reward: add_timed_idea = { idea = FRA_devalue_the_franc days = 365 }
nodes.original_description: 当他国进行货币贬值来挽救经济时，我国曾坚绝予以拒绝效仿，这造成了我国经济落后于人。如果我们想让竞争性更强并在面对山雨欲来的局势时能未雨绸缪，贬值货币的选项就不能完全排除在外，即使它不怎么受欢迎。

nodes.title: 高速公路
actions: if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT infrastructure < 5 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT infrastructure < 5 } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: random_owned_state = { limit = { is_core_of = ROOT infrastructure < 4 not = { has_state_flag = FRA_autoroutes_target } } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes } set_state_flag = FRA_autoroutes_target } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_core_of = ROOT infrastructure < 4 not = { has_state_flag = FRA_autoroutes_target } } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes } set_state_flag = FRA_autoroutes_target } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_core_of = ROOT infrastructure < 4 not = { has_state_flag = FRA_autoroutes_target } } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes } set_state_flag = FRA_autoroutes_target } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_core_of = ROOT infrastructure < 4 not = { has_state_flag = FRA_autoroutes_target } } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes } set_state_flag = FRA_autoroutes_target }
nodes.original_description: 德国以其连通国内各地全封闭但高速的道路震惊了世界。我们可以向世界证明我们也可以做到。

nodes.title: 开发本土
nodes.original_reward: add_stability = 0.05
nodes.original_description: 重建工业的第一步必须是改善我们在本土的工业基础。

nodes.title: 首都工业腹地
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }
nodes.original_reward: random_owned_state = { limit = { is_core_of = ROOT NOT = { has_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 set_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target random_neighbor_state = { limit = { is_core_of = ROOT is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { has_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 set_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target } }
nodes.original_description: 本土永远是第一位的。我们可以从改善基础设施开始，这能够提供工作机会并提高部队部署速度。

nodes.title: 工业扩张
actions: if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT industrial_complex < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT industrial_complex < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_industrial_expansion_effect_tt every_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT has_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 instant_build = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 我们需要在本土建立强大的工业存在。我们已经有了足够的工人，但我们需要更多的生产线。

nodes.title: 军用工厂
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }

if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_military_factories_effect_tt every_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { has_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target has_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 我们的军事机器因为生产能力不足而落后了。我们需要专注于本土的军事装备生产，以保证我们的部队能不断得到新装备。

nodes.title: 卢瓦尔发展计划
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }
nodes.original_reward: random_state = { limit = { OR = { state = 459 state = 460 state = 513 } NOT = { has_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target has_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } is_owned_or_subject_trigger = yes } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 set_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target set_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target random_neighbor_state = { limit = { OR = { state = 459 state = 460 state = 513 } is_owned_or_subject_trigger = yes NOT = { has_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target has_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 set_state_flag = FRA_industrial_expansion_target set_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } }
nodes.original_description: 欧洲正处于一个危险的时刻。我们应该专注于改善南边的领土，以保证我们可以一直对本土提供支援。

nodes.title: 地方发展投资
actions: every_owned_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT has_resistance = yes } add_compliance = 10 }
nodes.original_reward: every_owned_state = { limit = { not = { is_core_of = ROOT } not = { is_on_continent = europe } has_resistance = yes } add_compliance = 10 }
nodes.original_description: 我们在欧洲的工业腹地并没有足够的人口与资源来维持大规模的工业扩张。如果我们的经济想要同世界其他国家竞争，就必须利用我国的殖民地。

nodes.title: 投资布列塔尼
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }
nodes.original_reward: random_state = { limit = { OR = { state = 272 state = 780 state = 556 state = 779 state = 778 state = 781 state = 776 state = 777 } OWNER = { is_owned_or_subject_trigger = yes } NOT = { has_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 set_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target }
nodes.original_description: 西非庞大的劳工与资源储备使其成为投资的完美选项。

nodes.title: 投资诺曼底
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }
nodes.original_reward: random_state = { limit = { OR = { state = 741 state = 286 state = 671 state = 670 state = 1017 state = 1066 state = 1067 state = 1068 state = 1069 } OWNER = { is_owned_or_subject_trigger = yes } NOT = { has_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 set_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } IF = { limit = { VIN = { is_subject_of = ROOT } } VIN = { add_autonomy_score = { value = -150 localization = FRA_invest_in_indochina } } } IF = { limit = { CAM = { is_subject_of = ROOT } } CAM = { add_autonomy_score = { value = -150 localization = FRA_invest_in_indochina } } } IF = { limit = { LAO = { is_subject_of = ROOT } } LAO = { add_autonomy_score = { value = -150 localization = FRA_invest_in_indochina } } }
nodes.original_description: 我们在印度支那的资产和本土核心区之间的距离似乎拖了后腿，但这也使得建立在那里的任何工业免遭敌人的攻击。

nodes.title: 投资香槟
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }
nodes.original_reward: random_state = { limit = { OR = { state = 677 state = 680 state = 554 state = 553 } is_owned_or_subject_trigger = yes NOT = { has_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 set_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } IF = { limit = { SYR = { is_subject_of = ROOT } } SYR = { add_autonomy_score = { value = -150 localization = FRA_invest_in_syria } } } IF = { limit = { LEB = { is_subject_of = ROOT } } LEB = { add_autonomy_score = { value = -150 localization = FRA_invest_in_syria } } }
nodes.original_description: 一旦欧洲或非洲发生战争，叙利亚完全可以支持补给中转。提高其工业潜力也能够维持我们在附近地区的地位。

nodes.title: 地方工业建设
actions: if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT industrial_complex < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT industrial_complex < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_colonial_industry_effect_tt every_state = { limit = { is_owned_or_subject_trigger = yes has_state_flag = FRA_colonial_industry_target } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 instant_build = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 我们应该专注于我们殖民地的工业。这样我们可以在欧洲紧张度不断上升的时候，使一部分工业能力留在敌人的轰炸范围之外。

nodes.title: 支持大学校
actions: if = { limit = { amount_research_slots < 5 } add_research_slot = 1 } else = { add_political_power = 75 }
nodes.original_reward: add_research_slot = 1
nodes.original_description: 有前途的年轻思想家在各地不断涌现，我们需要为他们提供便利，让他们开展自己的研究。科技的进步可以让我们在最需要的地方取得突破。

nodes.title: 组建国家科研中心
actions: if = { limit = { amount_research_slots < 5 } add_research_slot = 1 } else = { add_political_power = 75 }
nodes.original_reward: add_research_slot = 1
nodes.original_description: 有前途的年轻思想家在各地不断涌现，我们需要为他们提供便利，让他们开展自己的研究。科技的进步可以让我们在最需要的地方取得突破。

nodes.title: 贯通地区经济
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_global_investments }
nodes.original_description: 不列颠帝国是一个相互支撑的精密体系。我们的殖民帝国没道理不能发展地同样好。

nodes.title: 开始重整军备
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }

if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 福煦元帅在1919年预测的二十年休战行将告终，这个世界不久就要陷入一场新的风暴。我们必须做好准备。

nodes.title: 重视防御
nodes.original_reward: add_command_power = 30 custom_effect_tooltip = available_chief_of_army show_ideas_tooltip = maxime_weygand
nodes.original_description: 在如今的时代，最好的手段就是加强防御。如果外面有威胁，那就让他们来进攻，这样我们就能在自己的地盘里消灭他们。我们拥有一个完美的候选人来领导军队，现在就等你的命令了。

nodes.title: 火力杀伤
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_firepower }
nodes.original_description: 一战的教训简单亦残酷： 士兵在开阔地上相互厮杀的日子已经过去。现在，通过大规模使用远距离的现代化武器就能完成杀戮。

nodes.title: 有序作战
actions: add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = SFP_methodical_battle category = land_doctrine uses = 2 cost_reduction = 0.65 }
nodes.original_reward: add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = FRA_methodical_battle category = land_doctrine uses = 2 cost_reduction = 0.65 }
nodes.original_description: 声称战斗就该是乱杀的都是蠢货。作战应当是基于整体的计划，有条不紊地运用正确的工具。只要妥善计划，敌人就可能仅是历史的小注脚。

nodes.title: 重视防御工事
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = FRA_fortification_focus
nodes.original_description: 我们的要塞依然和以前一样至关重要，我们需要更有效地建设它们。马奇诺防线对敌方部队来说是一个巨大的威慑，我们应该建造更多这样的防线来保证我们的安全。

nodes.title: 东南山地防线
actions: if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT bunker < 10 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT bunker < 10 } add_building_construction = { type = bunker level = 1 instant_build = yes province = { all_provinces = yes } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ROOT = { country_event = { id = france.3 } } ITA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = FRA_alpine_forts } }
nodes.original_description: 当我们完成在阿尔卑斯山脉的新防线后，意大利人就没那么容易跨过来了。我们将有足够的时间来作出回应并巩固我们的地位。

nodes.title: 延伸首都防线
actions: if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT bunker < 10 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT bunker < 10 } add_building_construction = { type = bunker level = 1 instant_build = yes province = { all_provinces = yes } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ROOT = { country_event = { id = france.2 } } BEL = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = FRA_extend_the_maginot_line_focus_neg } add_opinion_modifier = { target = GER modifier = FRA_extend_the_maginot_line_focus_pos } }
nodes.original_description: 我们不能指望比利时守住自己的领土。如果他们没能挡住敌军，那么我们就有麻烦了。延长马奇诺防线对阻挡奇袭之敌有着至关重要的作用！

nodes.title: 全民动员
nodes.original_reward: army_experience = 5 add_ideas = FRA_infantry_focus
nodes.original_description: 所有能够战斗的男性和女性都将被动员。大规模生产武器可以降低成本。我们要给每个人都发一把步枪。

nodes.title: 大炮阵
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_artillery_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = artillery }
nodes.original_reward: army_experience = 5 add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_artillery_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = artillery }
nodes.original_description: 我们的炮兵将组成一个单独的单位，以集中火力炮击特定目标。让所有大炮在同一时间进行齐射可以削弱敌人的阵线，如果需要，我们将不得不砸出一条通道！

nodes.title: 主战坦克
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_heavy_armor_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = cat_heavy_armor }
nodes.original_reward: army_experience = 5 add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_heavy_armor_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = cat_heavy_armor }
nodes.original_description: 主战坦克是法国军队发展的方向。我们必须控制战场，为此我们需要新的更强大的坦克！

nodes.title: 装甲师
actions: if = { limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Division Cuirassée" } } division_template = { name = "Division Cuirassée" regiments = { medium_armor = { x = 0 y = 0 } heavy_armor = { x = 0 y = 1 } medium_armor = { x = 1 y = 0 } medium_armor = { x = 1 y = 1 } motorized = { x = 2 y = 0 } motorized = { x = 2 y = 1 } motorized = { x = 2 y = 2 } } support = { recon = { x = 0 y = 0 } artillery = { x = 0 y = 1 } engineer = { x = 0 y = 2 } } } }

nodes.original_description: 一位名为戴高乐的进取军官提议组建一种新的部队，将重装甲、步兵和中型坦克结合成复合整体来执行作战。

nodes.title: 步兵坦克
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_infantry_tanks bonus = 0.5 uses = 1 category = armor }
nodes.original_reward: IF = { limit = { has_dlc = "Arms Against Tyranny" } mio:FRA_renault_organization = { add_mio_funds = 2000 } } ELSE = { custom_effect_tooltip = available_designer show_ideas_tooltip = FRA_hotchkiss }
nodes.original_description: 无论何时，坦克的第一和唯一要务就是确保步兵能夺下和保住阵地。因此，我们的步兵必须总是配备有先进而可靠的坦克。

nodes.title: 特种部队
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { special_forces } if = { limit = { has_dlc = "Arms Against Tyranny" } add_potential_special_forces_tree = yes }
nodes.original_description: 在未来，在常规步兵受限的环境中进行的作战会更加常见。我们必须新建一些更能适应特殊环境的部队。

nodes.title: 海军陆战队
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_fusiliers_marine category = tp_tech category = marine_tech uses = 2 bonus = 0.5 }
if = { limit = { has_dlc = "Arms Against Tyranny" } add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { cost_reduction = 0.5 uses = 2 category = special_forces_doctrine } }
nodes.original_reward: add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_fusiliers_marine category = tp_tech category = marine_tech uses = 2 bonus = 0.5 } if = { limit = { has_dlc = "Arms Against Tyranny" } add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { cost_reduction = 0.5 uses = 2 category = special_forces_doctrine } }
nodes.original_description: 海岸是无法攻破的防线的日子已经过去了。在未来，无论与我们交战的敌人在何处，我们都必须克服一切障碍来夺取登陆点。

nodes.title: 重视进攻
nodes.original_reward: army_experience = 25 custom_effect_tooltip = available_chief_of_army show_ideas_tooltip = maurice_gamelin
nodes.original_description: 我们不能眼睁睁地看着敌人逼近我们的边境。而且我们也不能在战争中抛弃盟友，让他们自生自灭。整备我们的军队！甘末林才是合适的人选。

nodes.title: 机动作战
nodes.original_reward: custom_effect_tooltip = available_theorist show_ideas_tooltip = charles_de_gaulle
nodes.original_description: 战场仅是将交火集中在一小片区域的陈旧观点已经消亡了。在大规模机械化、作战飞机和快速无线电通讯的情况下，战斗得以迅速地在数百公里长的战线上展开。为此，我们准备得越早越好。

nodes.title: 重视摩托化
nodes.original_reward: army_experience = 5 add_ideas = FRA_motorized_focus
nodes.original_description: 为我们的步兵建造更好的车辆可以提高我们支持和增援前线的能力。

nodes.title: 重视机械化
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_mechanized_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = cat_mechanized_equipment }
nodes.original_reward: army_experience = 5 add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_mechanized_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = cat_mechanized_equipment }
nodes.original_description: 装甲车辆在战争中的作用越来越大。尽管它们的威慑力比普通的坦克略低，但是却能在通讯、指挥、运输和城市战斗中发挥出自己的优势。

nodes.title: 装甲战斗车
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_light_medium_armor bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = cat_light_armor category = cat_medium_armor }
nodes.original_reward: army_experience = 5 add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_light_medium_armor bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = cat_light_armor category = cat_medium_armor }
nodes.original_description: 按规矩来说，所有的坦克部队归步兵管控。更轻更快的装甲车辆或骑兵坦克可以更适合于行军，并且可以用搭载的武器对敌人造成一定的伤害。

nodes.title: 空中霸权
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_air_dominance }
nodes.original_description: 飞机的发展成为了陆军第三个需要担心的侧翼。我们必须保护好这一侧翼的安全，否则就是一场灾难。

nodes.title: 发展近距支援机
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_cas_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 2 category = cas_bomber }
nodes.original_reward: add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_cas_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 2 category = cas_bomber }
nodes.original_description: 为我们的船只和地面部队提供近距离空中支援计划投入小但效果极佳。这些计划现在得到了一些改进的建议。我们的工程师可以以此设计下一代支援飞机。

nodes.title: 空地合作
actions: add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = SFP_air_ground_cooperation category = air_doctrine uses = 2 cost_reduction = 0.5 }
nodes.original_reward: add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = FRA_air_ground_cooperation category = air_doctrine uses = 2 cost_reduction = 0.5 }
nodes.original_description: 空战只有在猎杀地面目标的时候才会产生实际的军事收益。我们将空战与陆战协调得越好，战斗效率就会越高。

nodes.title: 空中火炮
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_flying_artillery }
nodes.original_description: 在快速运动的现代战场上，缓慢的地面火炮阵地可能无法跟上节奏。携带炸弹的飞机可以接替它们的角色。

nodes.title: 陆军改革
actions: add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = SFP_army_reform cost_reduction = 0.5 uses = 2 category = land_doctrine }
nodes.original_reward: remove_ideas = FRA_victors_of_wwi army_experience = 10 add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = FRA_army_reform cost_reduction = 0.5 uses = 2 category = land_doctrine } IF = { limit = { has_dlc = "Arms Against Tyranny" } mio:FRA_hotchkiss_organization = { add_mio_funds = 1500 add_mio_research_bonus = 0.02 } } ELSE = { custom_effect_tooltip = available_designer show_ideas_tooltip = FRA_AMX }
nodes.original_description: 单独使用步兵或高科技坦克并不能让我们赢得战争。我们必须努力改善自己的战术和战略能力。让合适的人来做这项工作，可以使我们真正变成一支军队。

nodes.title: 成立人民阵线
nodes.original_reward: add_country_leader_role = { character = FRA_leon_blum country_leader = { expire = "1965.1.1" ideology = socialism traits = { reluctant_interventionist stout_defender } } promote_leader = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = FRA_popular_front_cooldown value = 1 days = 360 } hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = obsolete_focus_branches_visibility option = HIDE } } mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 随着法西斯主义在德国和意大利的抬头，若要使我们的事业幸存，则必须要停止左翼各派之间的内耗。由所有左翼党派组成的泛人民阵线将得到民意授权，从而得以清除滋生法西斯主义的经济条件。

nodes.title: 任命共产主义部长
nodes.original_reward: FRA_right_wing_riot_effect = yes add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.05 } set_temp_variable = { communism_temp = party_popularity@communism } multiply_temp_variable = { communism_temp = 0.25 } add_stability = communism_temp hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = obsolete_focus_branches_visibility option = HIDE } } mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 由于害怕激进右翼的强烈反对，共产党人一直无法真正地进入政府之中。但是害怕解决不了任何问题。如果我们必须面对冲突，那就让它来吧。

nodes.title: 强化工会
nodes.original_reward: add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.05 } FRA_right_wing_riot_effect = yes
nodes.original_description: 长久以来，工人同志们集会去进行谈判的权利始终无法得以保护。现在再也不会这样了。

nodes.title: 纪念公社
nodes.original_reward: add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.05 }
nodes.original_description: 尽管寿命不长，但巴黎公社是第一个在法国大地上尝试建设共产主义的政权。

nodes.title: 妇女普选权
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_womens_suffrage } add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.05 }
nodes.original_description: 勤劳的法国妇女们一次次为了争取自己的权利而在街垒上战斗，却不被允许在选举中投票，这真是既荒唐又可耻。我们得铲除这种不公。

nodes.title: 法律平等
nodes.original_reward: FRA_right_wing_riot_effect = yes add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.05 }
nodes.original_description: 从各种意义上讲，妇女仍然被认为永远要服从男人意志的二等公民。这种荒谬的现状现在就要结束。

nodes.title: 工业集体化
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }

if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT industrial_complex < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT industrial_complex < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: random_owned_state = { limit = { is_core_of = ROOT is_controlled_by = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 1 include_locked = yes } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 instant_build = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 现在的法国经济是由许多雇员寥寥的小公司支撑的，它们永远都在互相掐架、争夺资源以满足于低效的小规模生产中。我们将把这些小公司合并起来，以成立可以在世界舞台上竞争的大公司。

nodes.title: 农业集体化
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_agricultural_collectivization } if = { limit = { set_temp_variable = { FRA_rw_support = party_popularity@neutrality } add_to_temp_variable = { FRA_rw_support = party_popularity@fascism } check_variable = { FRA_rw_support > 0.4 } } add_stability = -0.05 }
nodes.original_description: 适用于工业上的方法同样适用于全法国的农民们。负担不起现代设备的小农场，大多像祖辈一样传统劳作。通过把它们合并进农业生产单位，效率和产量将得以大大提生。

nodes.title: 强迫抉择
nodes.original_reward: set_temp_variable = { FRA_democratic_support = party_popularity@democratic } multiply_temp_variable = { FRA_democratic_support = -0.25 } add_stability = FRA_democratic_support custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_force_the_issue_tt set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no } if = { limit = { has_idea = FRA_disjointed_government } remove_ideas = FRA_disjointed_government } hidden_effect = { news_event = { id = lar_news.9 days = 3 random_days = 5 } }
nodes.original_description: 自人民阵线成立以来，我们已经取得了很大的进步。但是我们决不能让事业半途而废。是时候让所有左翼人士做出抉择了——革命，还是被革命。

nodes.title: 和解
nodes.original_reward: add_stability = 0.1
nodes.original_description: 在过去，法国革命总是将整个国家拖进革命与反革命恐怖的无尽痉挛中。也许是时候建立一个人们无论支持革命与否，都能各得其所的共和国了。

nodes.title: 制宪大会
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 120
nodes.original_description: 共和国性质的根本转变不会在一夜间完成，也不可能在未协商制定一部新宪法前完成。

nodes.title: 反法西斯联盟
nodes.original_reward: promote_character = FRA_rene_nicod add_trait = { character = FRA_rene_nicod ideology = marxism trait = reluctant_veteran } set_party_name = { ideology = communism long_name = FRA_union_populaire_long name = FRA_union_populaire } if = { limit = { NOT = { any_neighbor_country = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { has_government = democratic has_government = communism } } } } set_rule = { can_create_factions = yes } create_faction = FRA_anti_fascist_coalition every_neighbor_country = { limit = { is_in_faction = no OR = { has_government = communism has_government = democratic } } country_event = generic.5 } } else_if = { limit = { any_neighbor_country = { is_faction_leader = yes has_government = communism } } random_neighbor_country = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes has_government = communism } country_event = generic.2 } } else_if = { limit = { any_neighbor_country = { is_faction_leader = yes has_government = democratic } } random_neighbor_country = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes has_government = democratic } country_event = generic.2 } }
nodes.original_description: 法西斯主义的蔓延是我们前进道路上的最大威胁。我们必须同一切愿意与法西斯抗争的国家并肩作战，否则所有人都将永无宁日。

nodes.title: 邀请反法西斯移民
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_anti_fascist_immigrants }
nodes.original_description: 每个法西斯政权上台后所采取的首要措施必然是驱逐批评人士与针对国家政权的异见者。然而，这些人同时也是组建流亡政府的完美人选，以备在他们的祖国被解放的那一天派上用场。

nodes.title: 联系东部城市
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = STR STR = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } STR = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: every_other_country = { limit = { OR = { original_tag = YUG original_tag = HUN original_tag = ROM original_tag = GRE original_tag = CZE original_tag = BUL original_tag = ALB original_tag = SER original_tag = SLO original_tag = MNT original_tag = BOS original_tag = HRZ original_tag = MAC original_tag = CRO original_tag = TRA } exists = yes is_in_faction = no is_subject = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } OR = { has_government = communism has_government = democratic } } if = { limit = { ROOT = { is_faction_leader = yes } } country_event = generic.5 } else_if = { limit = { ROOT = { is_in_faction = yes } } random_other_country = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT is_faction_leader = yes } ROOT = { set_variable = { faction_leader = PREV } } } country_event = lar_fra_reconnect_to_the_balkans.1 } else = { custom_effect_tooltip = invite_to_faction_tt } }
nodes.original_description: 长期以来，法国都在藉由接触巴尔干国家来寻求中欧的平衡。尽管近年来遭到冷落，但这个联系始终存在。

nodes.title: 对法西斯先发制人
nodes.original_reward: every_neighbor_country = { limit = { has_government = fascism NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = ROOT } NOT = { is_guaranteed_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT } NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } ROOT = { create_wargoal = { type = topple_government target = PREV expire = 0 } } }
nodes.original_description: 为什么我们要容许敌人在和平时期备战，并且让他们挑选最合适的时机来发动无可避免的战争呢？我们将会抢先出击，在敌人还未准备妥善前粉碎威胁。

nodes.title: 与东方盟友协作
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MET MET = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MET = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: if = { limit = { SOV = { is_faction_leader = yes has_government = communism } } SOV = { country_event = generic.2 } } else_if = { limit = { SOV = { is_faction_leader = no is_in_faction = yes } } random_other_country = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes is_in_faction_with = SOV } country_event = generic.2 } }
nodes.original_description: 社会主义模式在苏联的实践可能并不是那么完美，但毋庸置疑，苏联已然最大程度地贯彻落实社会主义思想。我们若还想摸索自己的道路，就显得十分没见识。

nodes.title: 法国布尔什维克志愿者联盟
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_league_of_french_bolshevist_volunteers }
nodes.original_title: 法国布尔什维克志愿者联盟
nodes.original_description: 当一个社会主义国家处在外国入侵的威胁中时，所有的社会主义国家都处于威胁中。我们不能在我们的同志拼死抗争时坐视不管。

nodes.title: 接待洛林流亡者
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = STR STR = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } STR = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: add_relation_modifier = { target = GER modifier = FRA_host_the_german_exiles }
nodes.original_description: 德国，马克思与恩格斯的故乡，曾经是共产主义思潮的前沿与实践地。许多德国共产党人都在纳粹掌权时逃亡。如果我们给予其庇护，他们可帮助我们在解放区组织起一个更加有效的政府。

nodes.title: 向着极限革命
nodes.original_reward: add_war_support = 0.1
nodes.original_description: 半途而废的革命根本不是一场革命。我们决不能停下脚步，直至革命彻底完成以及新的政治制度得以保障，这将不惜一切代价。

nodes.title: 摧毁反革命
nodes.original_reward: set_temp_variable = { FRA_rw_support = party_popularity@fascism } add_to_temp_variable = { FRA_rw_support = party_popularity@neutrality } multiply_temp_variable = { FRA_rw_support = 0.5 } start_civil_war = { size = FRA_rw_support ideology = fascism }
nodes.original_description: 时至今日，国内仍有一小撮人正在密谋，一旦广大人民露出一丝破绽，便会用匕首狠狠背刺自己的同胞。为了不让他们得逞，我们会率先打击他们。

nodes.title: 革命热情
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = FRA_revolutionary_zeal
nodes.original_description: 法国人民向来有砸碎旧秩序来建立新秩序的热情，且听人民的怒吼吧。

nodes.title: 忠于事业
nodes.original_reward: promote_character = FRA_rene_nicod add_trait = { character = FRA_rene_nicod ideology = marxism trait = proletariat_internationalist } set_party_name = { ideology = communism long_name = FRA_union_populaire_long name = FRA_union_populaire } custom_effect_tooltip = generic_skip_one_line_tt set_rule = { can_create_factions = yes } create_faction_from_template = { template = faction_template_POR_popular_front_bloc name = FRA_communist_faction icon = GFX_faction_logo_generic_14 } custom_effect_tooltip = generic_skip_one_line_tt create_operative_leader = { name = "Jacques Duclos" GFX = GFX_portrait_jacques_duclos traits = { operative_infiltrator operative_natural_orator } bypass_recruitment = no available_to_spy_master = yes nationalities = { FRA } }
nodes.original_description: 其他国家可以从其自身角度诠释共产主义，但我国没有理由在这个问题上让步。他们可能会半途而废，围绕着目的与手段的问题纠结，而我们不然。

nodes.title: 向北输出革命
nodes.original_reward: create_wargoal = { target = ENG type = topple_government expire = 0 } custom_effect_tooltip = unlocks_espionage_operation_tt custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_instigate_workers_revolution_britain
nodes.original_description: 海峡对岸是工业革命的诞生地，也是现代资本主义的发源地。我们不能让这个地方成为反革命敌人的跳板。

nodes.title: 向西输出革命
nodes.original_reward: custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_carry_the_revolution_west_tt hidden_effect = { every_other_country = { limit = { original_tag = SPR not = { has_government = communism } } ROOT = { create_wargoal = { target = PREV type = topple_government expire = 0 } } } } custom_effect_tooltip = unlocks_espionage_operation_tt custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_instigate_workers_revolution_spain
nodes.original_description: 伊比利亚半岛的政权正命悬一线，随时可能被人民革命冲垮。我们就是最后一根稻草。

nodes.title: 向东输出革命
nodes.original_reward: create_wargoal = { target = GER type = topple_government expire = 0 } custom_effect_tooltip = unlocks_espionage_operation_tt custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_instigate_workers_revolution_germany
nodes.original_description: 东部边境的对面，是我等新秩序的最大威胁。反动势力集结在那里，随时准备在我们最无力承受的时候发动攻击——但我们不会留给他们足够的准备时间。

nodes.title: 向南输出革命
nodes.original_reward: create_wargoal = { target = ITA type = topple_government expire = 0 } custom_effect_tooltip = unlocks_espionage_operation_tt custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_instigate_workers_revolution_italy
nodes.original_description: 意大利是第一个沦陷于法西斯的国家。因此，这种意识形态在意大利也根深蒂固。阿尔卑斯两侧的世界观永无和平共处之时。他们和我们一样都清楚这一点，所以毫无疑问他们也在准备采取行动，就像我们正在做的一样。

nodes.title: 平等、自由、团结
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_egalite_liberte_solidarite }
nodes.original_description: 第一次法国大革命横扫了矗立千年的旧制度，永久地改变了欧洲的政治面貌。我们将完成自其以降的事业。

nodes.title: 改革劳动法
actions: if = { limit = { has_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_factory_strikes } remove_ideas = sof_van_prs_fra_factory_strikes }
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_matignon_agreements } if = { limit = { has_idea = FRA_factory_strikes } remove_ideas = FRA_factory_strikes }
nodes.original_description: 法兰西的工人们收入低、福利少，处于极恶劣的条件下工作。现在是时候实施一系列全面的改革措施来改善这种状况。

nodes.title: 国有化关键工业
actions: if = { limit = { has_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_2 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_2 add_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_1 } } else = { add_ideas = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_1 }
nodes.original_reward: swap_ideas = { remove_idea = FRA_inefficient_economy_2 add_idea = FRA_inefficient_economy_1 }
nodes.original_description: 在当前形势下，为了应对即将到来的威胁，我们不能回避经济结构的根本性调整。时间紧迫——我们不能等待自由市场来解决这个问题。

nodes.title: 重组航空工业
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }

if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { is_core_of = ROOT is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 1 include_locked = yes } } prioritize = { 16 24 15 20 31 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } } custom_effect_tooltip = CHL_skip_one_line_tt unlock_decision_tooltip = { decision = FRA_reorganize_aviation_industry_north show_effect_tooltip = no } unlock_decision_tooltip = { decision = FRA_reorganize_aviation_industry_west show_effect_tooltip = no } unlock_decision_tooltip = { decision = FRA_reorganize_aviation_industry_center show_effect_tooltip = no } unlock_decision_tooltip = { decision = FRA_reorganize_aviation_industry_south_east show_effect_tooltip = no } unlock_decision_tooltip = { decision = FRA_reorganize_aviation_industry_south_west show_effect_tooltip = no }
nodes.original_description: 数十年来，由于被拆分为几十家小公司，我们的航空工业已落后于德国和美国。彻底的重组十分必要。

nodes.title: 成立国有兵工厂
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }

if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 1 include_locked = yes } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 1 include_locked = yes } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } } custom_effect_tooltip = generic_skip_one_line_tt IF = { limit = { has_dlc = "Arms Against Tyranny" } custom_effect_tooltip = available_mio_tt show_mio_tooltip = FRA_amx_organization mio:FRA_amx_organization = { add_mio_size = 1 } }
nodes.original_description: 为了向我军提供现代化武器，我们不能等到私营公司发展出必要的生产能力。

nodes.title: 总工会
actions: if = { limit = { has_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_1 } remove_ideas = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_1 }
if = { limit = { has_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_2 } remove_ideas = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_2 }
nodes.original_reward: if = { limit = { has_idea = FRA_inefficient_economy_1 } remove_ideas = { FRA_inefficient_economy_1 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = FRA_inefficient_economy_2 } remove_ideas = { FRA_inefficient_economy_2 } }
nodes.original_description: 为了处理雇主和雇员之间的争端，我们将建立一个国家机构，来确保工人就业能人尽其才。

nodes.title: 统制经济
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_dirigisme }
nodes.original_description: 虽然苏联模式的全面计划经济显然是一个极端的措施，但要优化我国经济，一定的计划和方向措施不可或缺。

nodes.title: 龙头企业
actions: random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 }

if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT arms_factory < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }

if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT industrial_complex < 20 } } random_owned_controlled_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT industrial_complex < 20 } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 if = { limit = { free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 } } add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes } } else = { ROOT = { add_political_power = 40 } } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 1 include_locked = yes } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 1 include_locked = yes } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 1 include_locked = yes } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 instant_build = yes } } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 1 include_locked = yes } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 instant_build = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 通过选择一些有潜力在全球范围内竞争的公司，给予它们最大程度的支持，我们可以创造一个与其他任何公司同等强大的现代经济体。

nodes.title: 查禁联盟
nodes.original_reward: remove_ideas = { FRA_political_violence } set_temp_variable = { FRA_rw_support = party_popularity@neutrality } add_to_temp_variable = { FRA_rw_support = party_popularity@fascism } multiply_temp_variable = { FRA_rw_support = -0.5 } add_stability = FRA_rw_support
nodes.original_description: 极右翼联盟被允许不受约束地组织。虽然他们目前还很弱，无法发动政变，但谁也不知道他们将来能做些什么。最好现在就解散他们。

nodes.title: 地方公民权提案
actions: every_owned_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT has_resistance = yes } add_compliance = 10 }
nodes.original_reward: add_state_core = 459 add_state_core = 460 add_state_core = 513 if = { limit = { country_exists = ALG } annex_country = { target = ALG } } FRA_right_wing_riot_effect = yes
nodes.original_description: 法兰西共和国的公民身份应向任何符合条件的人开放。我们在阿尔及利亚的许多忠实臣民希望成为正式公民，但目前他们还不被允许这样做。通过使他们成为正式公民，我们将使阿尔及利亚与法国更加紧密地联系在一起。

nodes.title: 扩大公民权
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_expanded_citizenship }
nodes.original_description: 对一个共和国来说，不允许居住在其领土上的人成为公民是不可容忍的，然而这种状况却还在我们的领土上继续合法存在。这个错误必须立刻纠正。

nodes.title: 牢不可破的法兰西
actions: if = { limit = { has_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_expanded_citizenship } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_expanded_citizenship add_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_france_undividable } } else = { add_ideas = sof_van_prs_fra_france_undividable }
every_owned_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT has_resistance = yes } add_compliance = 10 }
nodes.original_reward: swap_ideas = { remove_idea = FRA_expanded_citizenship add_idea = FRA_france_undividable } every_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } NOT = { is_on_continent = europe } } add_compliance = 10 }
nodes.original_description: 法兰西必须在同一面旗帜下整合为同一个整体。现在是公开承认这一点的时候了，只要能消除对分裂的恐惧。

nodes.title: 法兰西联邦
actions: every_owned_state = { limit = { sofzh_unification_french_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT has_resistance = yes } add_compliance = 15 }
nodes.original_reward: hidden_effect = { country_event = lar_france_french_union.1 } if = { limit = { has_idea = FRA_political_violence } country_event = lar_france_political_violence.3 } custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_french_union_tt
nodes.original_description: 是时候宣称一个新的法兰西了，一个横跨全球的法兰西，我们国家的所有部分都团结在一起。我们将在每个部分举行全民公投，以确认人民的意愿，以此成立一个全新的、更伟大的法兰西。

nodes.title: 鼓励移民
nodes.original_reward: remove_worker_shortage_effect = yes
nodes.original_description: 我们的祖国正迫切需要工人来填补世界大战中遭受的损失。通过放宽移居法国的限制，我们能够吸引技术移民来弥补我们的不足。

nodes.title: 重审外交政策
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 120 hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_dlc = "La Resistance" has_game_rule = { rule = obsolete_focus_branches_visibility option = HIDE } } mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 1919年建立的大陆秩序似乎正在受到越来越严重的威胁。为了确保新的同盟能够经受住即将来临的风暴，现在是时候重新审视我们的对外政策了。

nodes.title: 西南志愿军计划
nodes.original_reward: unlock_decision_category_tooltip = FRA_spanish_intervention_category set_country_flag = FRA_non_intervention
nodes.original_description: 西班牙内战把意识形态冲突带到了我们的家门口。我们必须谨慎行动，以免冲突蔓延到国内。

nodes.title: 援助北方伙伴
nodes.original_reward: army_experience = 10 FIN = { add_manpower = 10000 add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 2500 producer = FRA } }
nodes.original_description: 芬兰人民正为了他们的生存而战。我们必须予以援助。

nodes.title: 重申东方承诺
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MET MET = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MET = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: every_other_country = { limit = { OR = { original_tag = YUG original_tag = CZE original_tag = ROM original_tag = POL } exists = yes not = { has_war_with = ROOT } } add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = FRA_confirm_eastern_commitments } } custom_effect_tooltip = available_political_advisor show_ideas_tooltip = rene_massigli
nodes.original_description: 一战结束后，我们在东欧建立了同盟网络。以对抗复苏的德国和扩张主义的苏联。我们在那里的盟友想知道，一旦收到请求，我们是否真的会去帮助他们。在他们决定另谋他路之前，我们应该先行安抚他们。

nodes.title: 巩固东部协约
nodes.original_reward: if = { limit = { CZE = { has_government = ROOT is_faction_leader = yes } } CZE = { country_event = generic.2 } } else_if = { limit = { CZE = { has_government = ROOT OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = ROOT } } is_faction_leader = yes } CZE = { country_event = generic.5 } } else_if = { limit = { CZE = { has_government = ROOT is_in_faction = no OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = ROOT } } is_in_faction = no } set_rule = { can_create_factions = yes } create_faction_from_template = faction_template_the_little_entente CZE = { custom_effect_tooltip = invite_to_faction_tt } hidden_effect = { CZE = { country_event = generic.5 } } }
nodes.original_description: 小协约国使我们对身处东欧和巴尔干的盟友负有援助义务。我们曾对其解体听之任之，但现在却比任何时候都需要之。是时候重建小协约国了。

nodes.title: 邀请阿尔萨斯
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = STR STR = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } STR = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: YUG = { country_event = france.17 }
nodes.original_description: 南斯拉夫是一个有足够分量而且没有扩张野心的邻居，邀请他们重回小协约国对于双方来看是一个很好的建议。

nodes.title: 邀请勃艮第
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = DIJ DIJ = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } DIJ = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ROM = { country_event = france.17 }
nodes.original_description: 罗马尼亚国家的民主局面是不稳定的，其内部的法西斯主义者和共产主义者相互斗争，在我们的支持下加入小协约国将保持他们国内的稳定。

nodes.title: 投资弱势盟友
nodes.original_reward: every_other_country = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT NOT = { is_subject_of = ROOT } check_variable = { num_of_military_factories < FRA.num_of_military_factories } } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_core_of = PREV free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 1 include_locked = yes } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2 add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes } } }
nodes.original_description: 我们若要在战争中同有力的盟友并肩，就必须使他们的军事能力满足其需要。一项对他们的工业进行适度投资的计划，可以使之有能力在当地生产所需的弹药。

nodes.title: 协调军备重整
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = LYO LYO = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } LYO = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: if = { limit = { is_in_faction = no } custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_coordinate_rearmament_tt } else = { every_country = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT } add_relation_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = FRA_coordinate_rearmament } } every_country = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT } ROOT = { add_relation_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = FRA_coordinate_rearmament } } } }
nodes.original_description: 为了同德国和其他敌人的实力增长相匹敌，我们必须与其他盟友协调共进。

nodes.title: 跨区劳工协作
nodes.original_reward: remove_worker_shortage_effect = yes
nodes.original_description: 劳动力不足是制约工业发展和军队规模扩大的重要瓶颈。从我们的盟友那里邀请技术工人到我们的工厂工作，可以释放出更多的人力来投入军队之中。

nodes.title: 整合地区协约
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = ROU ROU = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } ROU = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ENG = { if = { limit = { ROOT = { is_in_faction = yes } } country_event = lar_fra_join_the_ententes.1 } else = { custom_effect_tooltip = invite_to_faction_tt } }
nodes.original_description: 法国不能同时履行两项共同防御的承诺。除非让英国人和我们步调一致，否则就会陷入两难境地。通过将我们参与的不同协约整合成一个整体，我们与盟友的威慑能力就可以提高一个数量级。

nodes.title: 重建巴黎—梅斯协约
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MET MET = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MET = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: if = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes } POL = { country_event = generic.5 } } else = { give_guarantee = POL custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_revive_the_franco_polish_alliance_tt }
nodes.original_description: 法国始终支持波兰的独立。但近年来，两国间的关系有所冷淡。鉴于德国的威胁迫在眉睫，是时候重启我们的条约了。

nodes.title: 争取时间
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MET MET = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MET = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: custom_effect_tooltip = available_political_advisor show_ideas_tooltip = georges_bonnet if = { limit = { YUG = { is_guaranteed_by = ROOT } } ROOT = { diplomatic_relation = { country = YUG relation = guarantee active = no } add_ai_strategy = { type = ignore id = "YUG" value = 100 } } YUG = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = western_betrayal } } } if = { limit = { CZE = { is_guaranteed_by = ROOT } } ROOT = { diplomatic_relation = { country = CZE relation = guarantee active = no } add_ai_strategy = { type = ignore id = "CZE" value = 100 } } CZE = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = western_betrayal } } }
nodes.original_description: 我们还未做好与德国人在战场上兵刃相向的准备。我们的盟友还很弱小，我们的军队更是落后。如果我们想要存活下去，可能需要作出一些牺牲。

nodes.title: 强化政府
nodes.original_reward: set_country_flag = FRA_strengthen_government_support_focus_flag add_timed_idea = { idea = FRA_strengthen_government_support_focus days = 365 }
nodes.original_description: 我们已经做好了下一年的计划，以满足法国各地人民的需求。我们要向他们展示我们有能力采取行动并统治法国，我们将再次团结起来。

nodes.title: 防御战略
nodes.original_reward: remove_ideas = FRA_disjointed_government set_rule = { can_send_volunteers = yes }
nodes.original_description: 如果想让法国人民愿意打仗，最重要的是需要给他们一个明确的目标，我们必须停止内耗而为法兰西的自由、平等、博爱而战。

nodes.title: 与诺曼底协作
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = ROU ROU = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } ROU = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ENG = { country_event = { id = britain.13 } }
nodes.original_description: 在俄国永远改变后，旧三国协约之中只剩下英法两国。如果历史注定要重演，我们必须确保我们两国继续作为欧洲民主和自由的堡垒，继续同盟关系。

nodes.title: 开放地区军备市场
nodes.original_reward: USA = { country_event = lar_arms_purchases.1 } unlock_decision_category_tooltip = FRA_weapons_purchases_category
nodes.original_description: 我国军工业根本无法为军队提供不可或缺的现代化武器，而美国的生产力则有富余。我们有可能说服他们售予我们所需的武器，除非他们决定要奉行孤立主义。

nodes.title: 巴黎主导协约
nodes.original_reward: set_rule = { can_create_factions = yes } add_political_power = 120
nodes.original_description: 以法兰西的辉煌历史为证，我国决不会允许他国对外交政策指手画脚。我们将会根据本国利益，做出本国的选择。

nodes.title: 与马赛磋商
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MRS MRS = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MRS = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ENG = { country_event = lar_concessions_to_italy.1 }
nodes.original_description: 意大利仍然梦想着在非洲的帝业。如果我们作出一些让步，同时承认其对埃塞俄比亚的征服——我们也许就能阻止罗马柏林轴心的形成。

nodes.title: 批准南方协约
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MRS MRS = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MRS = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ITA = { country_event = lar_ratify_the_stresa_front.1 }
nodes.original_description: 意大利表示同意加入我们的阵营，以换取非洲的领土，那么就签署并批准必要的条约吧。

nodes.title: 首都与东方盟约
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MET MET = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MET = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: SOV = { country_event = lar_franco_soviet_treaty.1 } effect_tooltip = { SOV = { give_guarantee = ROOT } give_guarantee = SOV }
nodes.original_description: [SOV.GetAdjective]和我们一样担心法西斯在欧洲的崛起。如果时机成熟，也许可以说服他们支持我们。

nodes.title: 左派言论
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = maurice_thorez every_other_country = { limit = { has_government = communism num_of_factories > 30 } add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = FRA_leftist_rhetoric_communism } } every_other_country = { limit = { has_government = democratic num_of_factories > 30 } add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = FRA_leftist_rhetoric_democratic } } every_other_country = { limit = { has_government = fascism num_of_factories > 30 } add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = FRA_leftist_rhetoric_fascism } }
nodes.original_description: 目标很明确。那就是人人平等。我们不希望法国政治为资本主义的利益服务。我们有必要为共产主义组织的崛起提供最佳的条件。

nodes.title: 全国动员
nodes.original_reward: remove_ideas = FRA_disjointed_government add_ideas = FRA_national_mobilization_focus
nodes.original_description: 我们终于有了一个有能力采取行动的政府。现在我们应该增强部队的战斗力，准备为法国而战了。

nodes.title: 工人共同阵线
actions: if = { limit = { is_in_faction = no } create_faction = sof_van_workers_front }
nodes.original_reward: SOV = { country_event = { id = soviet.29 days = 1 } }
nodes.original_description: 我们在各处都遇到了敌人，我们需要和一些强大的盟友联手来加强自己的地位。我们和共产国际之间的联系愈加紧密，是时候全身心地投入到共产主义事业中了。

nodes.title: 人类团结
nodes.original_reward: set_rule = { can_create_factions = yes }
nodes.original_description: 肥头大耳的银行家和渴望权力的煽动者正逐步攫取这个世界。每一天我们都能看到自由的人被奴役，而世界慢慢地陷入由个人私欲而引起的危机之中。我们比以往任何时候都需要法国的理想！人类需要我们，我们应该团结全人类！

nodes.title: 复兴国民联盟
nodes.original_reward: add_country_leader_trait = tenacious_negotiator hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = obsolete_focus_branches_visibility option = HIDE } } mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 政治形势日益激化，左翼悄声议论着要与共产党达成合作。现在需要的是强力而稳定的领导。

nodes.title: 自由放任
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_laissez_faire category = industry uses = 3 bonus = 1.5 }
nodes.original_reward: add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_laissez_faire category = industry uses = 3 bonus = 1.5 } hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = lar_fra_inefficient_economy.1 days = 730 } } custom_effect_tooltip = FRA_laissez_faire_tt
nodes.original_description: 共产党公开要求通过极端手段重塑我国经济结构，即剥夺勤劳人民群众的正当财产。我们则用简单而掷地有声的自由理念予以回击。一个充满活力的经济体永远比一个官僚主义盘根错节的左派噩梦要好。

nodes.title: 保护人权
nodes.original_reward: add_stability = 0.05
nodes.original_description: 也许共产党永远不会开诚布公，但是人民群众的眼光是雪亮的：剥夺财产权是毁灭由先辈们呕心沥血争取到的所有权利的第一步，而这决不能被容许！

nodes.title: 自由阵线
actions: if = { limit = { not = { has_completed_focus = SFP_utilize_the_leagues } } add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = SFP_fascism } add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = SFP_fascism } }
else = { add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = SFP_democracy } add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = SFP_democracy } }
nodes.original_reward: if = { limit = { not = { has_completed_focus = FRA_utilize_the_leagues } } set_temp_variable = { FRA_fascism = party_popularity@fascism } add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = FRA_fascism } multiply_temp_variable = { FRA_fascism = -1 } add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = FRA_fascism } } else = { set_temp_variable = { FRA_democracy = party_popularity@democratic } multiply_temp_variable = { FRA_democracy = 0.3 } add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = FRA_democracy } multiply_temp_variable = { FRA_democracy = -1 } add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = FRA_democracy } } FRA_communism_riot_effect = yes
nodes.original_description: 当面对共产党所企图的混乱和剧变时，我们必须与其他党派结盟，即使是那些在我们看来是洪水猛兽的党派。

nodes.title: 激活市场
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_market_dynamism }
nodes.original_description: 动态市场已经被证明是各种经济体系中最有效率的形式。但是其仍旧由人来驱动，而人有时则需要保障，以使其辛勤劳动成果不会白费。通过立法取消一些限制并给予保障，我们可以帮助投资者克服恐惧并使其投入到刺激我国经济发展的事业中来。

nodes.title: 农业保护
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_agricultural_protectionism }
nodes.original_description: 我国传统的生产方式在世界经济发展中越来越居于不利地位。如果不采取措施保护农民，危机就会接连不断地到来，因为我们的农民在面对海外食品的大量涌入时毫无竞争力可言。

nodes.title: 经济分权
actions: if = { limit = { has_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_2 } if = { limit = { has_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_2 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_2 add_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_1 } } else = { add_ideas = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_1 } }
else_if = { limit = { has_idea = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_1 } remove_ideas = sof_van_prs_fra_inefficient_economy_1 }
nodes.original_reward: if = { limit = { has_idea = FRA_inefficient_economy_2 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = FRA_inefficient_economy_2 add_idea = FRA_inefficient_economy_1 } } else_if = { limit = { has_idea = FRA_inefficient_economy_1 } remove_ideas = FRA_inefficient_economy_1 }
nodes.original_description: 如果说，有的官员身处巴黎就能知道什么措施对于波尔多的公司有利，是太荒谬可笑了。我们必须信任那些企业家，让他们有能力就地解决自己的问题。

nodes.title: 鼓励创业
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_entrepeneurship }
nodes.original_description: 一个富有活力经济体的心脏永远握在那些从不让机会流失的人的手中。而近年来，冗余的规章制度将这种精神消磨殆尽，我们需要改变现状。

nodes.title: 取缔共产主义
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_communism_banned } set_temp_variable = { communism_temp = party_popularity@communism } multiply_temp_variable = { communism_temp = -0.25 } add_stability = communism_temp remove_ideas = FRA_political_violence
nodes.original_description: 虽然难以置信，但似乎确实有人真心实意地，期盼让共产主义革命在自己的祖国刮起混乱与血腥的风暴。我们不能继续纵容他们针对国家的阴谋诡计，必须严打严防。

nodes.title: 利用联盟
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 75 add_stability = -0.03 custom_effect_tooltip = generic_skip_one_line_tt unlock_decision_tooltip = { decision = FRA_rally_the_leagues show_effect_tooltip = yes } unlock_decision_tooltip = { decision = FRA_unleash_la_cagoule show_effect_tooltip = yes } hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = obsolete_focus_branches_visibility option = HIDE } } mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 可悲的是，政治暴力在法国已司空见惯。如果这个国家要在共产主义革命的威胁下生存下去，我们决不能忽视那些在街头撞见或行将撞见共产党暴徒的可怜人。

nodes.title: 民族重生
nodes.original_reward: hidden_effect = { create_country_leader = { name = "Pierre Laval" desc = "POLITICS_ÉDOUARD_DALADIER_DESC" picture = GFX_portrait_fra_pierre_laval expire = "1965.1.1" ideology = rexism traits = { tenacious_negotiator } } } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no } hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = obsolete_focus_branches_visibility option = HIDE } } mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes } }
nodes.original_description: 过度的民主和迷途的共和荼毒了我们的国家，撕裂了我们的同胞。治愈这些创伤需要很长时间，但千里之行，始于足下。

nodes.title: 粉碎堕落
nodes.original_reward: add_timed_idea = { idea = FRA_anti_decandence days = 365 }
nodes.original_description: 一个国家，如果允许自己在最无足轻重的议题上浪费数个月的时间去辩论，就永远不可能伟大。某些国家，在海洋的庇护以及全球帝国的支持下，可能以为有能力承受这种奢侈，但我们不能。

nodes.title: 整合主义
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 50 custom_effect_tooltip = available_political_advisor show_ideas_tooltip = charles_maurras
nodes.original_description: 整合主义的意识形态认为，社会的各个方面必须团结一致，犹如更大的整体中的一部分。这个社会必须有良好的秩序，以确保其各个部分和谐一致。

nodes.title: 劳动
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = { FRA_travail }
nodes.original_description: 工匠是国民经济中最重要的组成部分。在正确适当的指引下，把自己的劳动奉献给国家无疑成为了最崇高的志业。

nodes.title: 家庭
nodes.original_reward: add_stability = 0.1
nodes.original_description: 社会上最小的单位不是个人，而是家庭。为这个简单而明显的事实争论不休，是旧共和国最大的缺陷。

nodes.title: 祖国
nodes.original_reward: add_war_support = 0.1
nodes.original_description: 每一位[FRA.GetAdjective]公民，无论男女老幼，都有责任保卫并帮助自己的同胞。而实现这一点的唯一途径，只能是通过秩序以及对国家无条件的忠诚。对此绝不能有任何质疑，否则我们将重蹈旧共和国的覆辙。我们将采取一切必要措施来维持秩序与国家安全。最终，人民会明白这符合他们的根本利益。

nodes.title: 政治统一
nodes.original_reward: remove_ideas = { FRA_disjointed_government } add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = party_popularity@neutrality } add_popularity = { ideology = neutrality popularity = -1 }
nodes.original_description: 专制君主垮台以来，法兰西的历史充斥着政治内斗。团结则法兰西得胜，内乱则法兰西落败。因此，少数人的野心决不能损害多数人的生计。

nodes.title: 外交自由
nodes.original_reward: every_other_country = { limit = { OR = { tag = POL tag = CZE tag = YUG tag = ROM tag = HUN } is_guaranteed_by = ROOT } ROOT = { diplomatic_relation = { country = PREV relation = guarantee active = no } } } hidden_effect = { news_event = { id = lar_news.6 days = 3 random = 5 } }
nodes.original_description: 共和政府把自己束缚在东欧的人造建筑上，一旦我们撤回援助，这些建筑就会轰然倒塌。然而，这些束缚是负债而非资产，因此需要被剥离掉。

nodes.title: 南方城市协约
nodes.original_reward: set_rule = { can_create_factions = yes } create_faction_from_template = { template = faction_template_european_dominance name = FRA_latin_entente } create_country_leader = { name = "François de la Rocque" desc = "POLITICS_ÉDOUARD_DALADIER_DESC" picture = GFX_portrait_fra_francois_de_la_rocque expire = "1965.1.1" ideology = fascism_ideology traits = { retired_officer } } set_party_name = { ideology = fascism long_name = FRA_psf_party_long name = FRA_psf_party }
nodes.original_description: 罗马帝国继承者之间的兄弟情谊是不可否认的。日耳曼人统治欧洲大陆太久了。现在正是夺回我等与生俱来的权力之时。

nodes.title: 联合西南伙伴
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = BRD BRD = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } BRD = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: random_other_country = { limit = { original_tag = SPR OR = { has_government = ROOT has_country_leader = { character = SPA_francisco_franco ruling_only = yes } NOT = { has_global_flag = spanish_civil_war } } } IF = { limit = { ROOT = { is_in_faction = yes } } country_event = { id = generic.5 hours = 6 random_hours = 12 } } ELSE = { custom_effect_tooltip = invite_to_faction_tt } }
nodes.original_description: 刚刚从内战中恢复过来的西班牙，是我们尝试重塑这片大陆的天然盟友。

nodes.title: 邀请南特
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = NAN NAN = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } NAN = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: POR = { IF = { limit = { ROOT = { is_in_faction = yes } } country_event = { id = generic.5 hours = 6 random_hours = 12 } } ELSE = { custom_effect_tooltip = invite_to_faction_tt } }
nodes.original_description: 尽管她的殖民帝国已大大缩水，但探索和征服的火焰仍在每个葡萄牙人心中燃烧。

nodes.title: 对马赛的合作方案
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MRS MRS = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MRS = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ITA = { country_event = { id = lar_compensate_italy.1 hours = 6 random_hours = 12 } } effect_tooltip = { custom_effect_tooltip = needs_approval ITA = { transfer_state = 268 } FRA = { add_to_faction = ITA } }
nodes.original_description: 过去，争夺一小片沙漠的冲突就能把我们两国拖进战争的泥沼。要停止这种无理取闹简直不能再容易，很快我们就能找到让双方都满意的解决办法。

nodes.title: 地中海地区协作
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MOP MOP = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MOP = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: ITA = { country_event = { id = lar_intervention_in_greece.1 hours = 6 random_hours = 12 } } custom_effect_tooltip = needs_approval effect_tooltip = { ITA = { add_state_claim = 185 add_state_claim = 731 add_state_claim = 184 add_state_claim = 47 add_state_claim = 186 } FRA = { add_state_claim = 187 add_state_claim = 182 } }
nodes.original_description: 希腊控制着地中海一些最有价值的领土。为了不让敌国控制，我们必须首先采取行动。

nodes.title: 巴黎会议
actions: if = { limit = { is_in_faction = no } create_faction = sof_van_paris_congress }
nodes.original_reward: country_event = lar_congress_of_paris.1
nodes.original_description: 柏林会议确定了列强在非洲的边界，但现在看来像一块满是补丁的破布。现在是时候重绘地图，为新的殖民帝国奠基了。

nodes.title: 法国统一边界
nodes.original_reward: every_state = { limit = { OR = { state = 8 state = 980 state = 34 state = 6 state = 977 state = 35 state = 51 state = 42 } } add_claim_by = ROOT } custom_effect_tooltip = generic_skip_one_line_tt create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = BEL expire = 0 } create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = LUX expire = 0 } custom_effect_tooltip = generic_skip_one_line_tt IF = { limit = { HOL = { owns_state = 35 } } create_wargoal = { type = take_state target = HOL expire = 0 generator = { 35 } } } IF = { limit = { GER = { owns_state = 42 owns_state = 51 } } create_wargoal = { type = take_state target = GER expire = 0 generator = { 42 51 } } }
nodes.original_description: 一个国家首先考虑自己的利益是天经地义的，在我们的斗争中无法与德国人和平共处。因此，我们必须控制自然边界，以此保卫心脏地带。

nodes.title: 向着新法兰西前进
nodes.original_reward: add_stability = -0.05 create_country_leader = { name = "Jacques Doriot" desc = "POLITICS_ÉDOUARD_DALADIER_DESC" picture = GFX_portrait_fra_jacques_doriot expire = "1965.1.1" ideology = nazism traits = { eager_collaborator } } set_party_name = { ideology = fascism long_name = FRA_ppf_party_long name = FRA_ppf_party }
nodes.original_description: 法兰西正处在一个十字路口。我们可以把自己束缚在旧世界中，也可以起身拥抱新秩序。德国人正准备重构欧洲大陆，站在他们一边对我们有利。

nodes.title: 建立势力圈
actions: if = { limit = { country_exists = MET MET = { sofzh_unification_candidate = yes has_war = no NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } } has_war = no } MET = { country_event = { id = sof_van_diplomacy.1 days = 1 } } } else = { add_political_power = 40 }
nodes.original_reward: GER = { country_event = { id = lar_spheres_of_influence.1 hours = 6 random_hours = 12 } } custom_effect_tooltip = if_they_accept_tt effect_tooltip = { GER = { add_state_claim = 8 add_state_claim = 7 add_state_claim = 35 add_state_claim = 36 add_to_faction = ROOT } ROOT = { add_state_claim = 34 add_state_claim = 6 add_state_claim = 977 add_state_claim = 980 } }
nodes.original_description: 数百年来，两国人民相信双方是不共戴天的世仇关系，而这个观念建立在两国存在利益冲突的基础上。但我们一定能就划定双方势力圈和尽力克制互相干涉达成一份协议。

nodes.title: 皮卡第统一战役
nodes.original_reward: BEL = { country_event = { id = lar_split_belgium.1 hours = 6 random_hours = 12 } }
nodes.original_description: 随着比利时进入我们的势力圈，现在是时候召唤法语区回家了。其余部分将组建一个新的国家。

nodes.title: 北方地区统一战役
nodes.original_reward: BEL = { country_event = { id = lar_align_belgium.1 hours = 6 random_hours = 12 } }
nodes.original_description: 比利时的存在应归功于我们，我们不能让他们忘记这一事实。如果我们让他们保持独立存在，至少能确保建立一个友好的政府。

nodes.title: 扩张帝国
nodes.original_reward: transfer_state = 295 transfer_state = 538 transfer_state = 718 transfer_state = 769 transfer_state = 768 transfer_state = 890 transfer_state = 888 transfer_state = 889
nodes.original_description: 像比利时这么小的一个国家竟然被允许保留一个如此广袤的殖民地，无比荒谬。显然我们更适合管理这个地区。

nodes.title: 阿基坦统一战役

nodes.original_description: 长久以来失去的省份迟早都将回到我们的怀抱。世界上所有说法语的人最终都将与祖国统一。

nodes.title: 进攻部队

nodes.original_description: 新[GER.GetAdjective]在中欧的民主联盟正在威胁我们的新建立起的地位。现在，在他们变得更强大之前，我们必须就采取行动。

nodes.original_description: 德国已经成为欧洲霸主，他们所主导的未来更符合我们的利益，我们应加入轴心国，尘埃落定，法国会在未来的欧洲获得一席之地。

nodes.title: 首都王朝会议

nodes.original_description: 国家动荡不安，人民亟需一个强有力的领袖。很明显，共和主义让人民失望了，现在正是法兰西的君权神授回归之时。但首先，必须为恢复君主制奠定基础。

nodes.title: 修订宪法
nodes.original_reward: add_timed_idea = { idea = FRA_constitutional_revision days = 365 }
nodes.original_description: 共和宪法本就是一个权宜之计，但居然持续了这么久。现在，我们将重新修订这部宪法，允许君主重归王位。

nodes.title: 废止流放法
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 120 remove_ideas = { FRA_disjointed_government }
nodes.original_description: 根据现行的规定，任何统治过法兰西的王室族长或其继承人在未经许可的情况下，都不得在我国境内活动。因此，在实现君权复辟伟业前，我们必须先处理掉这个烦人的小障碍。

nodes.title: 奥尔良派复辟

nodes.original_description: 奥尔良家族在法国的保王党中获得了相当大的支持。尽管一些反对者倾向于另一位王位候选人，但毫无疑问，这位奥尔良派的继承人有最好的机会来和平团结他身后的国家。

nodes.title: 保障宪法
nodes.original_reward: add_stability = 0.1
nodes.original_description: 在共和派媒体有机会发动反对王室统治合法性的运动之前，我们必须通过给个人权利以强有力保障的方式来动摇他们的根基。

nodes.title: 国家第一公民
nodes.original_reward: add_country_leader_trait = constitutional_monarch
nodes.original_description: 国王虽然拥有相当大的权力，但决不能与旧时代的专制暴君等量齐观。与之相反的是，一个现代君主必须尊重法律，这是对抗那些非法篡权者的先头防线。

nodes.original_reward: add_timed_idea = { idea = FRA_counter_action days = 730 }
nodes.original_description: “法兰西行动”长期以来都是君主制复辟的最大鼓吹者。但很遗憾，他们在其他话题上的观点并不悦耳动听。兔死狗烹，他们已经没用了，该处理掉了。

nodes.original_description: 不为臣民服务的国王不是一个好国王。

nodes.title: 西南王朝远征

nodes.title: 东部统一战役

nodes.original_description: 在博罗季诺，拿破仑距离欧罗巴胜利仅一步之遥。彼时俄军几乎全军覆没，如果拿破仑能够再快一点，俄罗斯就会屈服在他的脚下。我们将向世界展示，这是可以做到的。

nodes.original_description: 法国大革命就像一场浪潮，卷走了长久以来统治欧洲老迈而虚弱的政权。现在，新的浪潮来了。

nodes.original_description: 尽管海军科技不断发展，海权的关键依然在于主力舰，再加以其他舰种的配合。不管主力舰是传统的战列舰还是新兴的航空母舰，我们都必须扩张造船工业，确保我们能与其他海军强国并驾齐驱。

nodes.title: 重视主力舰
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_capital_ship_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 2 category = bb_tech category = bc_tech }
nodes.original_reward: add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_capital_ship_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 2 category = bb_tech category = bc_tech }
nodes.original_description: 改进战列舰的设计可以为我们在战术上带来极大的优势。在它们无可抵挡的火力和射程之下，没有人能够逃脱。

nodes.original_reward: add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_carrier_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 2 category = cv_tech }
nodes.original_description: 海军理论家让我们把注意力转到了我们已经过时的航空母舰上。他们的建议指出了当发展方向正确时，我们应该如何更好地利用航母的性能。但真正的进展离不开我们的全力支持。

nodes.original_description: 航空母舰的优劣取决于舰载机的优劣。没有现代化的飞机，再好的航母都是一堆废铁。

nodes.original_description: 我们现有的航空母舰太过时了，无法与任何潜在的敌手相抗。我们必须把新型航母计划放在最优先的地位。

nodes.title: 新锐学派
nodes.original_reward: add_ideas = FRA_the_young_school
nodes.original_description: 航空，潜艇与鱼雷的最新发展表明，主力舰已经过时了。我们的海军工业有限，不能把时间和金钱浪费在建造巨型浮动堡垒上，因为它们在现代海军战场上毫无作用。我们应当专注于提升效率，建造更多小型船只。

nodes.title: 水下战斗
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_undersea_combat bonus = 1.0 uses = 2 category = ss_tech }

nodes.original_description: 近十年来，潜艇技术日渐成熟。现在，潜艇能对所有水面舰艇造成致命的威胁，同时还更难以被侦测或击沉。

nodes.title: 水面战斗
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_surface_combat bonus = 2.0 uses = 1 category = dd_tech }
nodes.original_reward: navy_experience = 25 add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_surface_combat bonus = 2.0 uses = 1 category = dd_tech }
nodes.original_description: 随着火炮的进步，在持续的恶战中，主力舰几乎不可能在另一艘主力舰的炮火下生还。一个舰队最佳的组成是现代化驱逐舰及鱼雷艇，以此向敌人倾泻似雨的鱼雷。

nodes.title: 改进屏卫舰
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_improved_screen_ships bonus = 2.0 uses = 1 category = ca_tech }
nodes.original_reward: navy_experience = 25 add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_improved_screen_ships bonus = 2.0 uses = 1 category = ca_tech }
nodes.original_description: 驱逐舰和轻巡洋舰是我们保卫重型战列舰和航空母舰的重要力量。如果我们在海上的防线失守，那么我们所有的船只和人员都将陷入危险之中。我们必须保证所有的舰只在建造时都采用了最新的科技。

nodes.original_description: 船只研发的最新进展使我们有了新的战略和战术选择，对这些新的理论我们需要有新的计划和实验来验证。

nodes.original_description: 我们需要时间来扩建空军！计划开工建设新的空军基地来支持更大规模的空军。

nodes.original_description: 一些革命性的技术可以用在战斗机上改善它的速度、航程和最大攀高，如果我们想要在战斗机技术上保持前沿就需要重视这点。

nodes.title: 重视重型战斗机

nodes.original_reward: add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_heavy_fighter_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 2 category = cat_heavy_fighter }
nodes.original_description: 我们的重型战斗机必须能更有效的打击轰炸机，这需要更强的火力、更快的速度和更远的航程。

nodes.title: 重视轰炸机
actions: add_tech_bonus = { name = SFP_bomber_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = tactical_bomber }
nodes.original_reward: add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_bomber_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 1 category = tactical_bomber }
nodes.original_description: 空中支援是战斗中无论进攻还是防守都不可或缺的一环，如果我们重点发展这点，将有更强大、更精准的轰炸机使我们在战场上保持优势。

actions: add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = SFP_air_doctrine cost_reduction = 0.5 uses = 2 category = air_doctrine }
nodes.original_reward: air_experience = 50 add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = FRA_air_doctrine cost_reduction = 0.5 uses = 2 category = air_doctrine }
nodes.original_description: 我们已经积累了足够的经验来测试空中作战的新理论，现代战争中空战是关键，而这将允许我们探索新战术和战略的可行性。

nodes.title: 重视重型轰炸机

nodes.original_reward: add_tech_bonus = { name = FRA_heavy_bomber_focus bonus = 1.0 uses = 2 category = cat_strategic_bomber }
nodes.original_description: 现代化重型轰炸机将拥有一定的空战能力，如果允许我们的工程师重点开发最新的重型轰炸机技术，我们将拥有一个更好的轰炸机来摧毁敌人的设施。

nodes.original_description: 我们的陆上边界几乎在阿尔卑斯山脉上。虽然阿尔卑斯山确实是一道难以越过的天险，但上次大战的经验表明，阿尔卑斯防线并非固若金汤。在边界上建设一系列堡垒将帮助我们将敌人的陆上进攻抵挡在国境线上。

nodes.original_description: 旧的战争方式早就应该烂在伊松佐的战壕里了。某些年事已高的将军仍然顽固不化地认为，只要把一大群士兵扔进绞肉机里，就可以像以前那样赢下战争。但如今，我们比这些人更加深谙战争之道：现代战争的胜利，离不开快速、灵活、反应迅捷的机动部队。我国陆军必须准备好打赢这种战争。

nodes.original_description: 有些人说，马儿与骑手驰骋战场的日子已经过去了，骑兵的角色应当被坦克和飞机所取代。但是他们错了——马可不需要喝油，也不需要地勤，只需要一副好马掌就够了。因此即使在现代战场上，骑兵仍存有明显的优势。

nodes.original_description: 直到现在，我们的空军最高指挥部仍然我行我素，没有很好地与我们的海军配合。这妨碍了意大利皇家海军进行有效的侦察任务。通过发展海空协调的联合作战方式，并加强两军间的通讯体系，我们的舰队可以更高效地寻找并打击敌人。

nodes.title: 扩张海军情报局

nodes.original_description: 意大利信号情报局一直以来经费都十分受限，运转很大程度上依赖乔治·韦里塔·波埃塔和路易吉·唐尼尼两位才子，但这种情况马上就要结束了。我们将给情报局配备更多人员，招募如埃利索·波尔托海军中尉的人才。如此，我们在破解敌方密码、揭示敌军动向方面将更有可能取得成功。

nodes.original_description: 我国对埃塞俄比亚的战争堪称灾难，意大利军队再一次遭受了连埃塞俄比亚都打不过的耻辱。我们已经像阿杜瓦的先辈们一样被击败了。我们无法想象，如此大规模的失败对法西斯体制的未来究竟意味着什么。

nodes.original_description: 阿杜瓦之耻已得洗刷。阿杜瓦大败的记忆困扰我们四十年之久，我们终于大仇得报。我们的军队在战争中证明了他们的实力，扫除了一切怀疑；现在世界也必须对我国我军另眼相看。

nodes.title: 召集岛内委员会
nodes.original_reward: add_stability = -0.05 add_political_power = 25 custom_effect_tooltip = available_political_advisor show_ideas_tooltip = ITA_pietro_d_acquarone ITA_bop_low_decrease_effect = yes if = { limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = obsolete_focus_branches_visibility option = HIDE } } mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
nodes.original_description: 我们必须召集法西斯大委员会来讨论如何处置墨索里尼。他最近对埃塞俄比亚的侵略，以及拒绝与别人分享权力和责任，使许多人对他的领导能力产生了质疑。他曾经很好地为这个国家服务，甚至代表了法西斯主义的风貌，但也许是时候换一个新领导人了……

nodes.title: 调整岛内货币
nodes.original_reward: add_stability = 0.02 add_timed_idea = { idea = ITA_devaluated_lira days = 365 }
nodes.original_description: 我们为这场战争所付出的代价大幅超出预期，国家经济也因此陷入其副作用的泥沼。贬值我们的货币能够使我们的产品在国际市场上更有竞争力，但会让普通意大利人民的生活水平有所下降——这是一个他们会愿意做出的牺牲。

nodes.original_description: 埃塞俄比亚的人民数个世纪以来都生活在皇帝的统治下。如果让我国国王加冕为埃塞俄比亚新皇帝，代替原来那位旧皇帝，我们治理埃塞俄比亚的任务将会简单许多。

nodes.title: 统帅崇拜
nodes.original_reward: add_country_leader_trait = lion_tamer ITA_bop_very_low_increase_effect = yes if = { limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = obsolete_focus_branches_visibility option = HIDE } } mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
nodes.original_description: 贝尼托·墨索里尼，非洲的征服者，阿杜瓦的复仇者，毫无疑问是自罗马帝国以来最重要的意大利政治家。他有着绝对的男子气概，勇敢而无畏的精神。我们应该让每个意大利人都明白，他们应该努力变成墨索里尼那样的人。

nodes.title: 天选之人

nodes.original_description: 墨索里尼不仅是时势所造的英雄，他的每一步都奉天之命，从而得以牢牢控制意大利。

nodes.title: 岛内教育改革
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 50 add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = 0.05 } add_stability = 0.02 custom_effect_tooltip = available_political_advisor show_ideas_tooltip = ITA_giuseppe_bottai
nodes.original_description: 罗马人的艺术和文化是现代欧洲文化的基础。我们决不能让那些历史瑰宝被现代主义艺术所取代。意大利人总是在展望未来，但从未忘记回顾过去。

nodes.title: 强化岛内委员会
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 50 add_stability = 0.05 ITA_bop_very_low_decrease_effect = yes custom_effect_tooltip = ITA_boost_the_grand_council_of_fascism_missiolinis_tt
nodes.original_description: 贝尼托·墨索里尼为意大利做了很多，但他始终只是一个凡人。如果他让国家误入歧途，法西斯大委员会将站出来阻止他。

nodes.title: 生如雄狮
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 50 swap_ruler_traits = { remove = lion_tamer add = lion_tamer_2 } ITA_bop_very_low_increase_effect = yes set_variable = { ITA_missiolinis_default_days = 350 } custom_effect_tooltip = ITA_to_live_as_a_lion_missiolinis_tt
nodes.original_description: 意大利人民并非生而为羔羊，他们不应该安于争夺历史舞台的配角之位，而是要牢牢把握住自己的命运！贝尼托·墨索里尼就是让他们这么做的人，他告诫所有人：一日生如雄狮，胜过百年碌似羔羊。

nodes.title: 粮食之战
nodes.original_reward: add_timed_idea = { idea = ITA_battaglia_del_grano days = 730 }
nodes.original_description: 一个国家如果连粮食都要依赖他国，便称不上真正的大国。意大利必须在基本粮食上独立自主，这样他国才会对我国更加敬畏。为了实现这一目标，我们必须如在战场上战斗一般进行这场名为粮食自给的战斗。只有先在粮食之战中取胜，我们才可能在战争中取胜。

nodes.original_description: 一个强大的法西斯社会的基础，正是土地和在其之上劳作的人民。在意大利仍有许多地方可以通过抽干沼泽和灌溉农田来得到富有价值的土地。

nodes.title: 生育之战
nodes.original_reward: add_timed_idea = { idea = ITA_battaglia_per_la_nascite days = 730 } add_political_power = 25
nodes.original_description: 如果我们想在世界上取得恰当的位置，我们必须有能够夺取如此地位的军事力量。为了这一目的，我们必须要有足够的士兵。对一对夫妻来说，养育仅仅一两个子女是远远不够的——在我们赢得军事上的战争前，我们必须先赢得生育上的战争。

nodes.title: 加强统治
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 50 add_stability = 0.05 add_war_support = 0.05 if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = ITA_the_man_of_providence } swap_ruler_traits = { remove = il_duce_providence add = il_duce_providence_strengthen } } else = { swap_ruler_traits = { remove = il_duce add = il_duce_strengthen } }
nodes.original_description: 争取经济独立的斗争证明了法西斯并非是如同先前的自由主义一样软弱可欺的意识形态。我们要让人民永远牢记这点。

nodes.title: 辛勤奉献
nodes.original_reward: add_political_power = 50 swap_ruler_traits = { remove = il_duce_providence_strengthen add = il_duce_devotion } ITA_bop_very_low_increase_effect = yes
nodes.original_description: 意大利人欠墨索里尼太多了。他凭借着纯粹的意志力，让意大利人得到全方位的提升。意大利人变得更加勇敢，富有，道德完善。意大利人唯一能够回报给墨索里尼的事便是万分感激他，并坚定地听从他的指挥。

nodes.title: 大众文化部
nodes.original_reward: add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = 0.05 } add_war_support = 0.03 add_political_power = 25 ITA_bop_very_low_increase_effect = yes
nodes.original_description: 我们的人民所获取的信息必须永远是准确的。在战时，敌方特工可以轻易地散播虚假信息。而我们必须向人民传达真实、准确的事件，以此与这些敌特分子对抗。

nodes.title: 相信、服从、战斗

nodes.original_description: 我党建立在朴实简单的信条上。首先，欲掌权者必先信之；其次，欲掌权者必从领袖；再者，欲掌权者必奋斗之。掌权是任何名副其实的政治活动的唯一真正目标。

nodes.original_description: 战争不总是一项光荣的任务。虽然大众可能会更加关注发生在前线的战斗，但我们清楚，后方的战斗也同样重要。例如，根除我们新得到的土地上的抵抗运动，就是一场十分必要的战斗。

nodes.title: 反间谍处

nodes.original_description: 现代战争是全民性质的战争。这意味着战斗并不止发生在前线。我们同样需要战斗人员确保通讯线路的畅通。

nodes.title: 治安民兵

nodes.original_description: 调用前线部队来保障后方地区的安全是对优秀士兵的浪费。我们应该建立一些专门保障军队后方安全的单位，来腾出更多的士兵，并将他们投入到前线的战斗中去。

nodes.original_description: 随着我们最近在非洲开疆拓土，一个崭新的时代浮现在了我们眼前。帝国蓬勃发展、我军建设得当，而我们也不再仅仅是一个王国了。我们终于可以昂扬地昭告天下：意大利帝国已冉冉升起！这一刻，我们等了太久了！
